==Description==
The '''Boomer 2''' was mostly regarded as a heated version of the [[Boomer 1]]. However, it was still affected by the flames of the [[Pyromancer]] and was just a stronger version of the [[Boomer 1]]. The '''Boomer 2''' was a much bigger threat compared to the [[Boomer 1]] due to its higher health and larger explosion size.

==Appearance==
The '''Boomer 2''' had a bloated appearance, similar to the [[Boomer 1]]. The only difference to the [[Boomer 1]] was the '''Boomer 2's''' red skin tone, pinkish torso and dark red legs.

==Strategy==
*Rapid-firing towers, such as the [[Minigunner]] or [[Sentry]], can kill the '''Boomer 2''' before it reaches your towers.
**The [[Commander]] can also assist in killing this enemy quicker by boosting the firerate of your towers.
*The [[Demoman]] and [[Rocketeer|Rocketer]] can kill hordes of these through splash damage, preventing them from getting anywhere near your towers.
**Additionally, the [[Ranger|Outlaw]] can also be used to kill the '''Boomer 2s''' from afar without the risk of being stunned.
*The [[Pyromancer]] and [[Freezer]] can be used to slow the '''Boomer 2''' down.

==Trivia==
*Even though the '''Boomer 2's''' appearance and narration prior to its debut suggested that they were immune to the [[Pyromancer]], it was not.
*The '''Boomer 2''' had no direct replacement in the [[Release v1.0|MEGA Update]], though it could be argued that the [[Boomer (Legacy)|Boomer]] was the replacement for both the [[Boomer 1]] and '''Boomer 2'''.
